checks.pass_condition: Original files available locally with provenance and usable formats; URLs or feature-only datasets are insufficient
At least 100,000 unique accepted images decode and yield finite, nonzero histograms; duplicates removed and rejections counted
Frozen nested 1,000 / 10,000 / 100,000 subsets, 30 separate query images and a small tuning set, with no byte-identical query/gallery overlap
Selected files pass the final preprocessing/descriptor pipeline; metadata inserts and reopens without truncation
About 30 valid clips and 5 query clips pass MFCC, vocabulary, vectorization and SQL, including MP3 decoding
Pilots at 1,000 and 10,000 measure extraction, K-Means and own HNSW time/RSS; the projected 100,000 workload fits the actual machine and window
Artifact sizes, hashes, IDs and required files recorded; reopening does not train models or regenerate vectors

host_observations_2026_11_06.physical_storage_note: The Windows system drive has about 32 GB free (97 % used). The WSL root reports 817 GB available, but that is the virtual disk's maximum size: the disk is a file on the same drive, so 32 GB is the real limit.

source_probes_2026_11_06.source: FMA small (8,000 MP3 clips of 30 s)

acquisition_strategy.images: Do not store train2017.zip: the zip plus its extraction (about 36 GB) exceeds the free storage. Use the annotations file as the image list and provenance, download selected images individually, record URL and SHA-256 of the original bytes, then keep an aspect-preserving copy with longest side <= 512 px (the first step of the frozen SIFT preprocessing). Estimated footprint 4-6 GB, to be measured in the 1,000-image pilot.
acquisition_strategy.audio: Candidate: about 35 FMA clips with permissive Creative Commons licenses selected from fma_metadata, fetched as individual zip members through HTTP byte ranges instead of downloading fma_small. MP3 originals are kept with their source, license, duration and SHA-256.
acquisition_strategy.status: PROPOSED; validated only when the pilot measures it
